description: This file defines the core App class of the Slim Framework, which manages middleware, routing, and request handling for a web application. It includes methods for adding middleware, error handling, routing, and running the app with incoming HTTP requests.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The core application class for the Slim Framework, responsible for managing middleware, routing, and request handling.

methods.name: getRouteResolver
methods.description: Returns the RouteResolverInterface instance used by the app.

methods.name: getMiddlewareDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the MiddlewareDispatcherInterface instance used by the app.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the middleware dispatcher stack.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a middleware instance to the middleware dispatcher stack.

methods.name: addRoutingMiddleware
methods.description: Adds Slim's built-in routing middleware to the middleware stack.

methods.name: addErrorMiddleware
methods.description: Adds Slim's built-in error handling middleware with configuration options.

methods.name: addBodyParsingMiddleware
methods.description: Adds body parsing middleware to the middleware stack with optional parsers.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the application: creates a request from globals if not provided, handles it, and emits the response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an incoming ServerRequestInterface through the middleware stack and returns a ResponseInterface, handling special logic for HEAD requests.
